name: email-campaigns

renderer_definitions.name: email_template_builder
renderer_definitions.description: Visual email template builder for reusable campaign templates, deterministic plain text preview, block selection, and TribeX workspace persistence.
renderer_definitions.rule: Use `email_template_builder` when the user wants to draft or edit reusable campaign templates.

renderer_definitions.name: email_campaign_launcher
renderer_definitions.description: Manual campaign launcher for artifact-backed templates and audiences with platform-owned prepare, preview, test, review, apply, and status workflow calls.
renderer_definitions.rule: Use `email_campaign_launcher` for approval-gated bulk campaign preparation and launch.

registry_index.summary: Reusable template building and manual artifact-backed email campaign launching.

tool_groups.name: Template Builder
tool_groups.hint: Open and validate reusable campaign templates.

tool_groups.name: Campaign Launcher
tool_groups.hint: Prepare, preview, test, review, apply, and inspect campaign sends.

tool_rules.email-template-payload-validate: Validates explicit template placeholders against normalized audience rows.
tool_rules.email-template-persona-test-prompt: Builds a safety-scoped persona prompt for one campaign test email.
tool_rules.email-campaign-persona-prompt: Builds an approval-gated campaign prepare/preview/test/review/send prompt.
tool_rules.email-template-persona-revision-prompt: Builds a same-path template artifact revision prompt.
tool_rules.email-template-visual-edit-prompt: Builds a metadata-only visual edit prompt.

plugin_rules: The Email Campaigns plugin owns reusable template building and manual campaign launch UI only.
Campaign send, tracking, compliance injection, and status operations remain platform-owned.
